name: ZhaoQing 2023
summary: In our ZhaoQing2023 initiative, we visited a remote location school in Guangdong Province, located almost 200 km away from Guangzhou. Our efforts were met with overwhelming success and serve as a successful proof of concept for international trips and future labs. The lab served more than 250 students and transformed an empty classroom into a digital gateway to the world!
projectText: In 2023, we brought over 50 computers---as well as digital literacy, knowledge, and hope-- to TanBo Elementary School in Zhaoqing, Guangdong, China.

name: Nepal 2024
summary: In 2024, the Envision team built two computer labs in Kathmandu, Nepal, one at Life Vision Academy (LVA) situated on a small mountain overlooking the Kathmandu Valley, and the second at Koseli, a school free of cost to attend for children in need located in the slum area of the city.
projectText: In Kathmandu, Envision Education partnered with Vishal Group Foundation to transform two schools into fully equipped technology labs. From building digital literacy to sharing laughter across cultures, the trip empowered students with tools, training, and hope—one computer at a time.

name: Nepal 2025
summary: In 2025, the Envision team established two new computer labs in Nepal—one at Chandi Devi School in the mountainous village of Dukuchhap, and the other at AUM School in Budhanilkantha. With the support of local partners like the Vishal Group, these labs are now transforming classrooms into centers of digital learning, empowering hundreds of students with access to technology, educational resources, and a brighter future.
projectText: In our boldest step yet, Envision Education returned to Nepal to establish digital labs at AUM and Chandi Devi Schools—bringing 50 new computers and sparking limitless curiosity. From lifting desks through windows to watching students research their dream careers, every moment was a reminder: we’re not just teaching tech—we’re building futures, one click at a time.

name: Meizhou 2026
summary: In 2026, Envision Education returned to Guangdong with our partner Shining Star, bringing twenty computers to a small campus deep in the mountains of Meizhou. The school has ninety-two students from grades one through five, and the lab we set up there was our sixth.
projectText: After the success of our expansions in Nepal, we set our sights on Guangdong province. With our partner Shining Star, we replaced a dusty, broken computer room with twenty new workstations for a mountain school of ninety-two students.
